reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT month, units,
  LAG(units) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_units
FROM monthly

)
SELECT m.month, m.units, p.units AS prev_units
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 MONTH

other_way.tradeoff: The self-join finds the month before by date, which stays right if a month is ever missing, but it is longer than LAG.
